label: Machine gun
game: One scout round. Loop to hear the 0.08s cyclic rate.

label: Gunship cannon
game: Gunship shell, one round.

label: Medium shell
game: Medium tank shell, one round.

label: Heavy shell
game: Heavy tank shell, one round.

label: Howitzer
game: Artillery shell, one round. The sim fires the pair 0.4s apart.

label: Incoming shell
game: Artillery round in the air, played at the target.

label: Rocket launch
game: Jet rocket leaving the rail.

label: Naval gun
game: Cruiser shell, one round, with the slap off the water.

label: Turret gun
game: Turret shell, one round, with the breech cycling.

label: Turret slew
game: Turret acquiring a new target. Not every round.

label: Bullet hit
game: A scout round that does not destroy the target.

label: Shell hit
game: A shell impact that does not destroy the target.

label: Rocket hit
game: A jet rocket impact that does not destroy the target.

label: Water impact
game: A round hitting open water.

label: Scout destroyed
game: Scout car destroyed.

label: Medium tank destroyed
game: Medium tank destroyed.

label: Heavy tank destroyed
game: Heavy tank destroyed.

label: Artillery destroyed
game: Artillery destroyed. The ready ammunition cooks off.

label: Gunship destroyed
game: Gunship shot down.

label: Jet destroyed
game: Jet shot down.

label: Cruiser destroyed
game: Cruiser sunk.

label: Turret destroyed
game: Turret destroyed.

label: Structure destroyed
game: Factory, airport, helipad, or shipyard destroyed.

label: Tree felled
game: A tree is brought down.

label: City razed
game: A city block is destroyed.

label: Select
game: A unit is selected.

label: Move order
game: A move order is accepted. The voice line carries the acknowledgement.

label: Attack order
game: An attack order is accepted.

label: Click
game: A button or build tile is clicked.

label: Invalid
game: The order is refused. A voice line gives the reason.

label: Building placed
game: A structure starts construction.

label: Construction
game: Played on a loop at the site while a structure is building.

label: Construction complete
game: A structure finishes. Pairs with the construction-complete voice line.

label: Unit ready
game: A trained unit leaves the bay. Pairs with the unit-ready voice line.

label: Credits in
game: Income tick. Loop while credits are arriving.

label: Credits out
game: Spend tick. Loop while credits are leaving.

label: Radar alert
game: Contact warning, with the under-attack voice line.

label: City captured
game: A city flips. Pairs with the city-conquered voice line.
